نستبطن (form X)
# نَسْتَبْطِنُ (nastabṭinu) /nas.tab.tˤi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
# نَسْتَبْطِنَ (nastabṭina) /nas.tab.tˤi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
# نَسْتَبْطِنْ (nastabṭin) /nas.tab.tˤin/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
